definitions.sentences: one utterance per LibriSpeech dev-clean speaker (the 40 sentences of W2 Demo 3; also W9 Demo 3's real-speech reference set)
definitions.noise: synthetic: white; pink (power ∝ 1/f); babble = other talkers from the same 40 sentences summed. One draw per sentence and type, reused at every SNR.
definitions.snr (input): 10 log10(sum s^2 / sum v^2) over the whole utterance; the speech is left untouched and the noise is scaled
definitions.cond key: noise|SNR|front end[|oa<omega>]; clean|<front end> = the front end applied to clean speech
definitions.front ends: none; stat = decision-directed Wiener written in numpy (enhance.py); mgan = SpeechBrain metricgan-plus-voicebank without the final peak normalisation; sep = SepFormer DNS4 16 kHz, rescaled by a least-squares gain against the noisy input
definitions.wer: corpus WER, word-level Levenshtein; references and both recognisers' outputs pass Whisper's EnglishTextNormalizer
definitions.sig.sdr / snr / sar: mean over sentences (dB) of the ratios from two projections of the front end's output: onto s, then onto span{s, v}. No delayed copies in the subspaces. sar_inf: the artifact term is zero (no front end).
definitions.sig.si_sdr / stoi / pesq: mean over sentences; PESQ is wide-band (ITU-T P.862.2) via the pesq package, STOI via pystoi; null if the package is missing
definitions.omega: observation adding: output = enhanced + omega * noisy input
definitions.spoof: AASIST as configured in W9 Demo 3: score = bona fide logit - spoof logit, called spoof if < 0
